components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        errors:
          title: Errors
          description: Names of the request fields that failed validation.
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - city
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - errors
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit value
            and, when the city has a known region (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
            Brisbane -> QLD), must fall within that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional on create; when present it is used to
            derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true on create, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner
            can be registered even though another owner already shares its household (the same last
            name, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace, and postcode). Such an
            owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. Otherwise a create sharing an existing household is rejected with 409
            Conflict. Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                on read; the raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with lastName.
                There are no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, i.e.
                owners with the same last name (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace) and postcode. It is the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners sharing a last name and postcode share it
                automatically, regardless of registration order.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email segment is empty when no email
                is present, the householdId segment is empty when it has not yet been assigned).
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two members
                of the same household with different telephones have different keys and are both
                allowed.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 0
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts at 1,
                gains 1 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, derived from the region-and-hash customerCode - the
                region segment before the first '-' of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'). This is
                the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the fixed city-to-region
                table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read - 'EMAIL' when an
                email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate relative to the
                registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or over. Present only when a birthDate has been supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (i.e. share
                today's registration date), signalling an unusually high daily signup volume;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner whose last name
                and postcode this owner shares (with a different telephone); otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

The spec called for membership **level 4 to require tenure of more than 365 days**, so a brand-new owner (zero tenure) never exceeds level 3.

**The problem:** `Owner.getMembershipLevel()` in `src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java` computed a level from pre-tenure factors (start at 1, +1 for an email, +1 for `namesakeCount == 0`) and then hard-capped it at 3 (`Math.min(level, 3)`) — level 4 was documented as "reserved for tenure" but was never actually reachable, and there was no tenure logic at all.

**The change** (`Owner.java:216`):
- Kept the pre-tenure factors capped at 3.
- Added a tenure gate: `+1` when `registrationDate` is set and the whole days from `registrationDate` to today exceed 365, then capped the result at 4.
- Since a newly created owner's `registrationDate` is today, its tenure is 0, so it stays at ≤3 — exactly matching the example (email + `namesakeCount` 0 + 3-member household → level 3, not 4). Household member count was never a factor in the formula; it's just descriptive context in the example.

I also updated the two Javadoc/doc descriptions to match (`Owner.java` and `openapi.yml`, raising the schema `maximum` from 3 to 4).

**Verification:** The existing acceptance test `coreNewOwnerCappedAtLevel3` (asserts a new emailed, unique-named owner returns `membershipLevel: 3`) passes, and the full `./mvnw test` suite reports `BUILD SUCCESS`.
